notes: Evals 1-4 and 6 target frozen copies under evals/fixtures/ so results stay comparable across iterations (a live target that absorbs the skill's own fix lists softens the eval continuously). Evals 1-5 use file scope; eval 6 is the folder-scope eval. Eval 3 is a judgment-call eval: its rules/ path is deliberately ambiguous and it does NOT count as memory-branch coverage. Eval 4 is the pinned memory-branch eval. Eval 5 targets a live working-tree file and is non-comparable across iterations. Verify quote expectations with evals/scripts/check_quotes.py, which takes one or more targets and expands a folder to SKILL.md plus references/. Guard calibration lives in evals/calibration/.

evals.prompt: Grade the writing in plugins/steyle/skills/grading-markdown-style/evals/fixtures/scriptify/SKILL.md against our style guides. What would it take to get it to an A?
evals.expected_output: A style review report that applies the universal and skill guides, gives one A-F grade, and lists every line-level fix needed to reach an A
expectations: The report states that both the universal guide and the skill guide were applied, with a reason
The report contains a single letter grade A-F under a Grade heading
The report has a 'Fixes to reach A' section where each entry gives a rule ID and a fix, and is anchored to a line number or explicitly marked file-wide
Quoted offending text appears verbatim in the target fixture (verify with evals/scripts/check_quotes.py)
The frontmatter description of the target SKILL.md is not counted as a violation
